message.content:
This document is a technical README/engineering log for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for running large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer and prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

## Models & Quantization
- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (320B total / 18B active): Maya quants named by model + tier (XS/S/M/L by expert bit-width). Sizes 94.7–156.3 GB; accuracy 97.
